seoTitle: Broken Link Checker for a Single Web Page
metaDescription: Test up to 25 unique HTTP links on a public page and review failed responses.
intro: Test up to 25 unique HTTP links on a public page and review failed responses.
aboutTitle: What does a broken link scan test?
about: The scanner fetches one public page and checks up to 25 distinct HTTP or HTTPS links it finds. The report shows response codes and connection failures for those links.
example: Scan an article, open a destination reported as 404 and confirm the address in your browser. Replace the link or restore the destination if the error is reproducible.

faqs.question: Is every failed check a broken link?
faqs.answer: A login prompt, rate limit or automated-request block can cause a failed check. Confirm the destination before changing the page.
